kind: adversarial addition: one mutation (must reject) + one near-miss (must accept) per covered rule
description: Table-driven extension of the 20-rule base suite. It does not modify rules.json or run_strict_rules.py. Each mutation attempts a cast/alias/equivalent-form bypass of the named rule and must still be rejected with the exact diagnostic substring; each near-miss is a legal boundary form that must be accepted. Coverage is a representative five-rule subset.

cases.bypass: cast: launder the overflowing +1 literal through (int)1u
boundary: 2147483646 + 1 reaches INT_MAX exactly, no overflow
alias: index p[5] through int *p = a instead of a[5]
equivalent form: sizeof(a)/sizeof(a[0]) - 1 is the last valid index
alias: cplus_check_live(q) where q aliases released owner p
fresh owner: release p, then use a separately allocated q
alias: release(p) then release(q) where q aliases p (OWNER-DOUBLE-FREE)
linear per path: if/else each release p exactly once
function boundary: worker calls helper bump() that writes shared global
require: multiple threads mutate shared global 'shared_counter' without synchronization

cases.bypass: synchronized equivalent: same shared write under pthread_mutex lock/unlock
